entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Checkboxes in Blazor filters disappear when updating options in .NET MAUI Blazor #61893
  • Cannot use a custom $(PackageId).props or targets file in a razor class library project #61891
  • Make sure .NET WebAssembly runtime features are properly documented #61890
  • Perf regression: multiple_queries #61887
  • [OpenApi] SourceGen on preview version: Property or indexer 'IOpenApiParameter.Example' cannot be assigned to #61885
  • SqlServer Distributed cache: Allow application to handle DuplicateKeyException #61884
  • Quarantine `FormWithParentBindingContextTest.CanUseFormWithMethodGet` #61882

Closed

  • Some projects need to add <InterceptorsNamespaces> with the latest aspnet builds #61177
    Backlog
  • Regression in v10 Preview 4 during a roll-forward from v9 causing System.TypeLoadException #61842
    10.0-preview5
  • Perf regression: fortunes_dapper #61879
  • Known Build Error: `CanUseFormWithMethodGet` fails #61880
    .NET 10 Planning
  • InvalidOperationException when decompressed data exceeds request body size limit #61723
    10.0-preview5
  • Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi generates bad server list (no domain), breaking Swagger and Scalar #61252
  • Perf regression: updates #61874

PullRequests

Created

  • [IIS] Manually parse exe bitness #61894
    feature-iis, area-networking
  • Fix handling for Name property on DisplayAttribute #61888
    area-minimal, feature-validation
  • Enable msbuild server on internal builds #61886
    area-infrastructure
  • fix(DbContextHealthCheck): propagate OperationCanceledExceptions instead of reporting unhealthy #61883
    area-healthchecks, community-contribution

Merged

  • Exclude some files from PR checks #61889
    area-infrastructure, 10.0-preview5
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #61843
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, 10.0-preview5
  • Block test that is failing after switching to latest-chrome #61881
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-navigation, 10.0-preview5
  • InvalidOperationException when decompressed data exceeds request body size limit #61812
    community-contribution, area-middleware, 10.0-preview5
  • [main] (deps): Bump dotnet/arcade from 43abe63bfc701d34e6599490a557a74710693410 to d7540e540636883d3d080d087223d28b6b7395ae #61851
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, 10.0-preview5
  • Use Microsoft.NETCore.App.Ref version in place of legacy MicrosoftNETCoreAppPackageVersion #61860
    area-infrastructure, 10.0-preview5
  • Add default implementations for new interface methods in Blazor JS interop #61850
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview5

Updated

  • Tolerate null ValidationContext in validation resolver APIs #61854
    area-networking
  • [DO NOT MERGE] Install scripts update validation PR #58587
    * NO MERGE *, pending-ci-rerun, 10.0-preview1
  • Implemented the JWT Token refresh logic through the OpenIdConnectHandler #61861
    area-auth
  • Fixed devtools url used for debug with chrome and edge #61813
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • perf: improve allocations in `OwinEnvironment` #58917
    Perf, area-networking
  • [Blazor] Use `Microsoft.DotNet.HotReload.Agent` package #61821
    area-blazor
  • Update `ResourceCollectionProvider` to take advantage of Declarative persistent component state #61748
    area-blazor
